prompt:
Create exactly ONE isolated transparent PNG electrical effect sprite for a 2D side-view fighting game: the red lightning attack of Incubus in the original Silent Hill (1999, PlayStation). This is the winged final boss's RED discharge, not Incubator's blue lightning.

Observed source frame: Silent Hill Memories video "Silent Hill 1 - Final Boss: Incubus (Nowhere)", VYrT1-Z4N6Y, nominal 3:04, shows very thin jagged forked lightning, a pale yellow-white hot core, warm orange-red inner edges and a dark red outer glow. Preserve that specific warm lightning identity. For the existing versus projectile render, translate it into ONE horizontal disconnected lightning discharge, moving LEFT to RIGHT: one sharp irregular main zigzag with 3 to 5 thinner branching forks, sparse short side filaments, tapering sharp tips at both ends. No central orb and no radial starburst. White-yellow core is narrow, red-orange halo is restrained and translucent; no blue, no cyan, no purple. Shape must read as angular electrical forks, never fire tongues, smoke or a molten lava streak.

Composition: a wide horizontal canvas about 3:1, effect centered and fully contained with at least 15% transparent safety margin all around. ONE static snapshot only, not multiple attacks, not a sequence, not a contact sheet. No character, wings, body, hands, magic circle, cloud, scene, weapon, floor, UI, text, label, border, logo or watermark. Real transparent alpha background, no opaque black rectangle or baked checkerboard. Fine crisp bright core, subtle feathered luminous alpha edge, suitably restrained for an eerie late-1990s survival-horror atmosphere. This is an original static authored interpretation of the documented effect for the versus renderer, not an extraction or a claim of exact original pixels.
